description: Turn a recipe the cook pasted, typed or linked to into a Befana draft: ingredients matched to Befana's list, steps rewritten in plain words with amounts as tags, and servings, times, timers and tags filled in. Pass text (up to 20,000 characters) or url (a public recipe page; a Pinterest Pin or pin.it link works too: Befana follows the Pin to the recipe it saved), not both. Nothing is published. Show the cook the draft (title, servings, ingredients and steps), point out anything listed in guessed, and ask them to confirm or change it. Then publish with create_recipe({ draft_id }) plus only the fields they changed, or give them edit_url to review and publish on the website. For a photo of a recipe card, read it yourself and pass the text. Limited to 20 drafts a day per cook. Already on Befana: when the link (checked before anything is fetched) or the recipe itself matches one the cook can see, no draft is made and existing lists those recipes ({ slug, url, title, owner_is_you, is_original }, the cook's own first, then the original): send the cook there (save_recipe keeps it in their kitchen, fork_recipe makes their own version, update_recipe changes their own), and pass add_anyway: true only if the cook says it's a different recipe. Some sites (NYT Cooking and other subscriber sites) only open for their own readers: then blocked is set and nothing was read. If you can see the page's recipe yourself, pass its text with source_url set to the link; otherwise the cook can open Befana's /new on their device and share the page from there (a link in the result).

add_anyway.description: Draft it even though it matched a recipe already on Befana (only when the cook says it's a different recipe)

source_url.description: With text: the web page the recipe text came from, to credit it and to find it if it's already on Befana

text.description: The recipe as the cook gave it, in any format

url.description: A public recipe page (http or https), or a Pinterest Pin link

name: draft_recipe
title: Draft a recipe from text or a link
